metadata.title: Soul Food Still Life Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio still life featuring a central brown paper grocery bag overflowing with southern staples, set against a deep black void. A cylindrical food tin with a portrait sits atop the bag, surrounded by raw ingredients like collard greens, sweet potatoes, watermelon, and hot sauce.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stack of groceries creating a central totem
Deep black background isolating vibrant food textures
Arched display typography framing the top of the composition
Warm, earthy tones contrasted against a single bright red bottle cap
coreInvariants: Hard studio lighting with soft fall-off on textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical column of groceries occupying 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cylindrical tin at the top of the grocery bag serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the arched title, moves down the central tin, through the collard leaf, and fans out to the peripheral ingredients at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, solid black surrounding the central cluster on three sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Earthy browns and tans from paper bags and potatoes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red from the hot sauce and watermelon flesh.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; colors are saturated but grounded in natural, organic tones.
paletteRestrictions: No cool-toned blues or purples in the lighting

letterConstructionRules: Main title follows a wide, symmetrical arch
High-contrast script with thick downstrokes and thin flourishes
Secondary text uses a condensed, heavy slab serif with rounded corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capitals feature exaggerated, curly swashes
Lowercase 'i' dots are circular and pronounced
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Calligraphic display script paired with blocky, industrial slab serifs for packaging labels.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s-era decorative flair and weight
Provides the necessary thickness and fluid connections

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio still life of a brown paper grocery bag on a black surface against a black background. The bag is filled with collard greens, sweet potatoes, a bottle of red hot sauce, a wedge of watermelon, and a tin can on top. Lighting is warm and directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched decorative script text in a golden-yellow hue across the top. Add secondary slab-serif text on the tin can label following the cylinder's curve.

verificationChecks: Does the text follow a symmetrical arch?
Are the food textures sharp and tactile?

adjustableVariables: Specific food items in the bag
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the tin
The portrait on the tin label
Record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the watermelon seeds are visible for texture
Check that the hot sauce bottle has a distinct red cap
Verify the arched text does not touch the groceries
Confirm the lighting creates a clear highlight on the tin can
recipe.reuseFormula: Still life + Black Void + Arched Script + Earthy Palette
